cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.32% · WTI +2.88% · Brent +3.59% · NatGas +4.14%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +3.04%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +3.04%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.84%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at -6.86%
cards.body: Leaders: EQNR +4.15%, VLO +3.77%, DVN +3.26%, MPC +3.16%, APA +3.15%. Laggards: SEDG -6.86%, LEU -6.22%, RUN -6.11%, EOSE -6.03%.
